example.title: Grant Road Bridge, Grant Road over Broad Branch Creek

brief: Small single-arch rubble-stone road bridge of about 1898: a semicircular barrel of roughly 8-10 ft span with a ring of long rough-split voussoirs set in random rubble spandrel and wing walls of the same grey stone, topped by a low rubble parapet with no rail. Carries a narrow two-lane asphalt street through steep wooded ground over a boulder-strewn stream. (Span estimated from photos.)
